subject: Zoning Ordinance Update Phase Two Scope
overview: The committee discussed the scope for the next phase of the city's zoning ordinance updates, focusing on aligning the code with comprehensive city plans and addressing technical revisions. The body approved motions to coordinate with city departments on procurement and to clarify the intent of existing zoning language.

items.title: Phase Two Zoning Ordinance Revisions (22-533)
items.summary: The committee and planning staff discussed priorities for phase two of the zoning update, including map changes, corridor guidelines, and aligning the ordinance with city plans for housing, climate, and economic development.

items.title: Technical Clarification Meeting
items.summary: Approved a motion to hold a future meeting with the Building Commissioner and planning staff to clarify the legislative intent of the current zoning draft and address outstanding technical issues.

items.title: Draft Scope of Work Development
items.summary: Approved a motion for the Council President to coordinate with the procurement department and planning staff to develop a formal draft scope of work for the zoning update project.
